limits: One before/after pair per width and runtime; eight fresh sequential native Windows processes, no concurrent local pytest.
In-memory QStandardItemModel, 100000 fully selected rows, four columns, real shortcut/capture, hidden view and QObject recording sink.
Includes escape/TSV encoding and complete string extraction; excludes native clipboard QString conversion, ownership and OS interaction.
Rows and full text digest match each pair; native clipboard, undelivered external notifications and end-to-end input latency remain unverified.
Total time increases in all four pairs; individual model/Qt calls and scheduling can exceed the cooperative budget.
Observed maximum after callback is about 157.30 ms; no universal responsiveness or speedup claim.
